title: The re-blessed a11y_scale@65s golden is absent from the PR body's re-bless table, leaving its cause undocumented
evidence: _pr_body_viscomm_crisis_duck.md:59-67 "Exactly **6 crisis-carrying T2 frames** ... | `goldens/juice/65000ms.png` | ... | `goldens/a11y_{deutan,protan,tritan}/65000ms.png` | ... | `goldens/a11y_reduced/65000ms.png` |" — yet `git diff --stat <merge-base> HEAD` lists 7 modified goldens including "goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png | Bin 93968 -> 95879 bytes"; the diff hunk also shows "diff --git a/goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png b/goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png index 2a97b36c..635acaf7 100644 Binary files ... differ"

title: palcheck section 7's premise pin message hardcodes 850 while the check names 'per-mille' — fine, but the fixture geometry math is duplicated rather than derived from draw_packets
evidence: harness/palcheck.odin (diff): "check(view.palette.lane_speeds[1] == 850, \"section-7 premise: standard lane speed is the shipped 850 per-mille\", int(view.palette.lane_speeds[1]))" and later "frac := 0.5 * f32(view.palette.lane_speeds[1]) / 1000.0; pkt_x := view.off_x + (f32(4) + 8.0 * frac) * view.tile_px * view.scale" vs draw_packets computing the same lane frac via "ppm := v.palette.lane_speeds[lane]; frac = min(1.0, frac * f32(ppm) / 1000.0)" (view.odin:1858-1862)
detail: The rider-position prediction re-derives draw_packets' math by hand. The premise pins catch drift for lane speed + span, so a future draw change fails loudly here — acceptable, and the comment documents exactly this.
recommended_fix: None required; optionally reference view.odin's line in the premise comment so a future retune greps here.

title: The new crisis_packet_involvement_chain test leaks its loaded catalogs (WARN in odin test output)
evidence: `odin test app/render` output: "[WARN ] ... render.crisis_packet_involvement_chain +++ leak 17B @ ... [catalog.odin:494:catalogs_load()] ... +++ leak 896B @ ... [catalog.odin:834:catalogs_load()]" — the test defers `delete(src.*)` but never `pp.catalogs_destroy(&cat)`; sibling tests (spawn_fx_test path) show the same pre-existing WARN class (topology_spawn_node leaks)
detail: Adds ~100KB of reported leaks to the test log (dev tracking allocator); masks genuinely new leak reports in the same package. Pre-existing class in this package, so note-level.
recommended_fix: Add `defer pp.catalogs_destroy(&cat)` after the successful `pp.catalogs_load(&cat, &src)` in the test.

title: crisis_packet_involved re-resolves pipe→bundle per packet per frame (O(packets) linear pipe_slot lookups) — pattern-consistent but a hot-path candidate
evidence: app/render/crisis.odin:215-220: "if p.on_edge { bslot, ok := pp.pipe_slot(topo, p.edge) ..." called from draw_packets per packet: view.odin:1999 "recede_pkt := desat > 0 && !crisis_packet_involved(crisis, topo, bundles, p)" — and core/topology.odin:549-552 shows pipe_slot is itself a linear scan "for i in 0 ..< len(t.pipe_alive) { if t.pipe_alive[i] && t.pipe_id[i] == id {"
detail: During crisis, each packet costs O(pipes) via pipe_slot. Same idiom draw_packets already uses for position (ps, ok := pp.pipe_slot), so this matches existing patterns; only a concern if packet×pipe counts grow.
recommended_fix: None now; if profiling shows cost during crisis frames, precompute a pipe_id→slot map per capture/draw like draw_packets' existing single resolution and pass it in.
